Product Features

  • Total dimensions: 60 x 40 x 170 cm. This white freestanding display cabinet exudes modern, minimalist elegance, instantly enhancing the style of your living room and adding vibrant accents.
  • Unique look: The display case has two transparent acrylic panels arranged on top of each other, which perfectly set the scene for decorative items, give your living room an artistic touch and become an eye-catcher.
  • Multi-layer storage: The interior consists of two tempered glass panels at the top and bottom, and a medium-density fiberboard in the middle, which divides the display case into four storage areas. The two tempered glass panels are adjustable to accommodate decorative items of different sizes. Books, accessories, collectibles and more can be stored here and will meet your diverse storage needs.
  • Durability: Made of MDF, it has a total load capacity of up to 80 kg. Its sturdiness provides a stable hold for everything from books to exquisite decorative items – for peace of mind.
  • Ambience: The colour and brightness of the LED light strip can be infinitely adjusted via a mobile app. This creates a lively atmosphere at gatherings and a warm, lively lighting effect in everyday life, giving your living room a lively atmosphere.
  • Easy to clean: The high-gloss surface of the front is smooth and delicate, making it incredibly easy to clean. A gentle wipe removes dust and stains and ensures that the display case always looks like new. The high-gloss finish is limited to the front of the cabinet.
  • Door Design: The cabinet features a single-door design that is easy to open and close and is durable. It is made of acrylic and has a soft-close hinge for smooth opening and closing.
  • Space-saving: The ideal size ensures that it does not take up too much space. It is perfect for a living room corner or on a wall. It complements sofas, paintings and other items and enhances the overall aesthetic of your living room.
  • Style compatibility: The white cabinet design blends easily into any interior style, from modern to minimalist to Scandinavian.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages that may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages arrive before assembly.

Descriptions

Descriptions

Dimensions: 60 x 40 x 170 cm. This free-standing display cabinet with a high-gloss finish (front only) is suitable for living spaces. It features a single door with transparent acrylic top. The interior is divided into three levels, with the upper and lower levels separated by tempered glass. The LED light strips are controlled via a mobile app. The rest of the display case is made of MDF panels. Total weight: 80 kg. Available in white.
